Scope: road works, storm, sewer, potable water and TSE networks, electrical works, fence and gates, a bridge and landscaping. Contract value 86.8M SAR, 24 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At 77.0% against a plan of 50.1%, the project is 26.8% ahead (SPI 1.54). This week it gained 1.80% against 1.04% planned, close to last week's 1.77%. The schedule now forecasts completion 173 days after the contract date, 25 days earlier than last week's forecast.

Well ahead on progress, but the forecast finish is still almost six months late. Both the weekly report and the P6 update forecast completion on 09-May-2028, 173 days after the contract completion date of 18-Nov-2027, with −148 days of total float (−169 last week). This is 25 days earlier than last week's forecast; the report does not say why. Every other open milestone slipped another 7 days, the fourth weekly slip in a row. Roads and medium voltage, the WBS that is behind plan (73.5% against 100%, unchanged for four weeks), depends on the MV network, which is waiting for the MODON–SEC agreement; MV cable, ring main units and lighting substations have not been ordered.

The two sources swap the dates of two milestones. The weekly report forecasts roads and medium voltage on 08-Feb-2027 and the deep network on 10-Jul-2027; the P6 export gives the same two dates the other way round. All other forecasts agree. Completion moved 25 days earlier, but every other open forecast moved 7 days later than in the 03-Nov report, so the approvals and purchase-order milestones (21-Nov and 15-Nov last week) are now due on 28-Nov and 22-Nov-2026.

Data notes

Built from the 10-Nov-2026 weekly upload (W07), with the 03-Nov-2026 upload (W06) for this week's changes.

  • Week number: the report states week 50.86 (whole weeks since site handover: 50); the file reference is WPR-051.
  • Physical progress differs between sheets: the dashboard shows 77.0% (549,913 of 714,561 man-hours), while the P6 export and the Physical-Chart Data sheet show 78.5% (560,740 man-hours).
  • The weekly summary file (works executed this week) and the Look Ahead and Conclusion sheets label cost-based progress as "actual"; this report uses physical % complete (man-hours) only. The weekly summary file also gives project code JDH3-03-011, contract value 86,742,345 and an expected finish of 30-Nov-2026, as does the Look Ahead sheet; the dashboard and P6 forecast 09-May-2028.
  • MODON PM: Eng. Abdallah Aljulayfi in the General Information sheet; م. رضا المنشاوي in the Look Ahead sheet and the weekly summary file.
  • Milestones: P6 and the weekly report still swap the roads/MV and deep-network forecast dates, and the dashboard's "Original (Baseline)" column shows last week's forecasts (e.g. 03-Jun-2028 for project finish). The finish moved 25 days earlier while total float improved by 21 days (−169 to −148); the report gives no reason.
  • Manpower: the November manual head count (182) and equipment count (75) are identical to October's; the equipment plan is 56 in the summary and 57 in the breakdown, and cumulative equipment actual stays at 564 from July. The free-float and failed-start figures (105 last week, 116 this week) are copied unchanged from the previous report.
  • HSE inspection of 10-Nov-2026 repeats the 03-Nov results exactly (7 good, 13 need improvement, 3 failed, score 0.73). The quality audit log scores the 10-Nov-2026 audit 0.73, while the dashboard's "this week" quality score is 0.86.
  • Material Monitoring: the revised quantity of traffic signs fell from 215 to 206 (all delivered), and paint on cement plaster shows 1,520 m² installed (1,350 last week) although none is recorded as delivered.
  • The Procurement Log file is identical to last week's, unchanged for the fourth week running.
  • Invoice 8 changed value (gross 4,214,425 to 4,915,324) with the same submittal revision 0; its 36,000 deduction, also shown as penalties on the dashboard, has no stated reason.
  • HDPE pipes: the Major Quantities sheet does not name the network, and its plan to date for the 8,722 m line is 6,872,936 m (variance −6,864,236), an obvious entry error.
  • Several dashboard cells show #REF! errors.
